name: devin
installHint: Visit https://devin.ai/cli for install instructions; the Devin CLI is currently invite-only and requires DEVIN_API_KEY.

quirks.notes: Devin executes in Cognition's cloud sandbox; local file edits are streamed back via the API. Long-running tasks may exceed quantum-loop's per-story watchdog timeout (>30 min). Prefer for fan-out exploration tasks rather than tightly-scoped story implementation.
